description: Land Acquisition - Egoda Uyana, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister for a public purpose to acquire specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the lots, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses entirely on land matters (acquisition of property) rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
